name: Fire in the Hole
flavour: The Drifter waits for a crowd worth the noise.
text: A blast that catches nine or more creatures lands a Mini Crit on every one of them.
vfx: a big blast in a packed crowd, every creature in it flashing the mini crit's pale gold number
art_prompt: a big cartoon blast going off in the middle of a tight huddle of tiny desert critters, little gold stars popping over every one of them
